description: Send one console command to a running gameserver. Requires confirm=true. Not every game accepts commands here: FiveM/RedM (txAdmin) and some games reject them, so use the txAdmin Live Console or config files instead. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: send_gameserver_console_command
title: Send Game Server Console Command
